Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::chooseSupplier(supplierID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = supplierID),
		currentOrderProduct: OrderProduct = CurrentOrderProduct
	precondition:
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		currentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let foundSupplier: Supplier in
		foundSupplier.oclIsNew() and
		CurrentOrderProduct.Supplier = supplier
}
